title: 0.137.0: how to get all paths of a router?

### Example Code

```python
for route in router.routes:
   route.path  # the `path` attribute may not exist
```


### Description

In Jupyverse we check for path conflicts in plugins [here](https://github.com/jupyter-server/jupyverse/blob/448e02d4f05f36b14180b471b02ccac977081a7c/api/api/src/jupyverse_api/app/__init__.py#L49-L50), and this started to [fail](https://github.com/jupyter-server/jupyverse/pull/641) with v0.137.0.

answer.body:
Thank for the report @davidbrochart and everyone here. :coffee: 

Would this work for you all? https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/pull/15785

For example:

```python
from fastapi.routing import iter_route_contexts

for route_context in iter_route_contexts(router.routes):
    print(route_context.path)
```

Check the tests in the PR, they show the equivalent use cases.

It would be great to get feedback before merging and releasing.
